svg.aria-label: A test rig for a glass button. A 120 × 32 capsule of glass sits on a carriage that slides on two guide rods inside a frame, held at rest by four coil springs, two at each end. A finger probe hangs from a carriage on a rail behind it: it comes down to press the glass, which swells, then slides along the rail to pull, and the glass leans after it, giving less the further it goes. A dial gauge at the end of the frame reads the lean. Let go and the springs bring it back, once past rest.
